name: Barbell Press Sit-Up
steps: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent, feet planted firmly, and a barbell held straight above your chest with locked elbows.
Brace your abs tightly and keep your wrists stacked directly under the bar.
Sit smoothly upward off the floor while pressing the barbell steadily toward the ceiling until it locks overhead above your shoulders.
Roll your spine slowly back down to the floor while keeping the bar balanced directly over your chest.
tips: Keep your wrists stacked straight beneath the bar so the load stays balanced overhead.
Use a light barbell and control the descent without letting your torso collapse.
